title: Controlled RAMA vs Mean vs RAMA-no-rank on rel-f1 (dual-task) and rel-amazon (rank ablation)
summary: Demo notebook for the RAMA (Rank-Aware Moment Aggregation) experiment comparing 3 GNN aggregation methods: standard mean baseline, RAMA full (rank + cardinality gating), and RAMA no-rank ablation. Loads pre-computed results from rel-f1 dataset (driver-position regression + driver-dnf classification, 5 seeds x 3 methods = 30 runs). Demonstrates the standalone RAMA PyTorch module with unit tests on synthetic data, reproduces statistical analysis (Cohen's d effect sizes, paired t-tests, DerSimonian-Laird pooled effects), and visualizes per-task metrics, effect size forest plots, training curves, and gate statistics.
